description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two different models under three distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categorical groups, ordered from left to right as "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini". The vertical axis represents the "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.25. A small, faint grey shaded rectangle is visually emphasized on the vertical axis exactly at the 0.50 mark. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing a cluster of three bars placed side-by-side. According to the legend in the top left, the bar colors represent different conditions: grey indicates the "Control" condition, light blue represents "Before Introspection Training", and dark blue denotes "After Introspection Training". Each bar includes a vertical grey error bar extending above and below its top edge. For the GPT-4o category, the grey Control bar is at approximately 0.10, the light blue Before Introspection Training bar reaches about 0.55, and the dark blue After Introspection Training bar is roughly 0.74. For the GPT-4o-mini category, the grey Control bar is the shortest overall, extending slightly below the 0.00 baseline to approximately -0.01, while the light blue Before Introspection Training bar is at approximately 0.51, and the dark blue After Introspection Training bar is the tallest overall at approximately 0.75. The bars within each group are consistently ordered from left to right as Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training, with no other specific sorting applied to the main categories.
